name: Claude Mem
description: Install claude-mem and configure it to capture Claude Code/Codex session memory.

version.description: Enter a claude-mem npm version (e.g. '13.24.0'), or use 'latest'.

ide.description: Which IDE integration to register claude-mem hooks for.

provider.description: Which memory provider claude-mem uses to compress sessions. 'claude' reuses your logged-in Claude Code CLI's OAuth credentials (requires the claude-code feature/binary to be present, regardless of the 'ide' setting). 'host' expects an OpenAI-compatible server already listening on 127.0.0.1 (claude-mem does not start one itself) — Codex CLI does not expose such a server out of the box, so this option is only practical if you run your own bridge.
